decision_rule: On one server and slot with distinct cache-disabled prompts, per-step native LLAMA_TRACE accepted A/N widths must be at or below request cap. Require response echo, positive per-step records and sum of widths equal native draft_n for each request; attribution incomplete or mismatch is UNKNOWN. Require a positive >1 width on a cap-7 control to establish the instrument can discriminate. One observed violation is OVER_CAP; absence cannot support a universal claim. Dry-run is separate; no redraw of exposed interrupted sequence.
